note: 2.0.141: contacts sync top-up behaviour + fewer interruptions. A refused click point (point not on the WeChat window) now activates WeChat and retries the guarded click once before the run stops - diag_20261014171335 logged 91 click_refused / 91 aborted rounds in a single run because WeChat was behind another window (only 76 of 600 clicks succeeded). Rows whose contact already has a WeChat ID are skipped, so each run only tops up the ones still missing an ID. Keeps 2.0.140: no blind clicks, transient-empty re-poll, skip failed rows, resume anchor.
